posts.author: Cooco
posts.title: Piss n' Poop mod
posts.html:
I think that not only should you be able to eat, seriously, where does all that stuff go?


Now introducing Pee and poop mod, where you can piss on dead people (although that would be illegal, wouldn't it?) or take a crap on your neighbors doorstep!


Ok, thats that for the introduction. Basically what i would love to see is a mod where you can /poop or /pee once in a while, not excessively much due to obvious childs wanting to pee all over the nexus etc. lets say after 5 chinese food, its time to poop perhaps.

I don't know what should affect the pee thing, but just admit it, it would be awesome to pee on the guy you just took hostage.

Anyone else for this?

posts.author: Cooco
posts.title: Car upgrades
posts.html:
Just because we all want it, we need something to throw our money down the sink at.

This is the super-expensive 100k car tuneup tool, which tunes your car up to be faster OR more controllable!

This would be a good idea I think, but every car has a max tuneup. say that the trabbis max tuneup is the lowest speed for the golf. the golfs max tuneup is the lowest speed for corvette (maybe not) and the corvettes tuneup is more handling especially. But speed could be put aswell.


Any other suggestions like this?
